errors.text: The proposed Mg getter is incorrect; the target process uses external titanium sponge as the oxygen getter.

Adding 5 wt% Mg directly to the ink would alter the intended equiatomic alloy chemistry and could introduce Mg/MgO contamination; Mg is also highly volatile at the proposed homogenization temperature.
The proposed argon, 1100°C for 2 hours regime conflicts with vacuum sintering below 3×10^-6 torr at 1400°C for 18 hours, followed by quenching from 1500°C.
The predicted 1–5 µm quenched grain size is inconsistent with the reported 33 ± 19 µm grain size.
The cited evidence does not support Mg oxygen scavenging, the proposed decomposition temperatures, the sintering schedule, phase stabilization, or grain-size prediction.
